import sys, json, time, resource, io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from formats import read_request
from pipeline import execute

# 2048 distinct fragments of length 16, 200000 non-matching packets
disc = []
for i in range(2048):
    vals = [0,0] + [1515 + (i % 13), 1516 + (i % 7)]*8 + [0,0]
    acts = [0,0] + [100]*16 + [0,0]
    disc.append({'class': 0, 'values': vals, 'activation': acts})
rel = {'id':'m','classes':1,'width':16,'eps':[1,1],'ratio':[1,2048],'threshold':[0,1],
       'mode':'range','packet_limit':200000,'idle_us':10**12,
       'discovery':disc,'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1515]*16}],
       'validation':[{'class':0,'values':[1515]*16}]}
blocks=[[['install','m']]]
nflow=8192; per=24; extra=3392
ops=1
for f in range(nflow):
    fid='f%d'%f
    block=[['open',fid]]; ops+=1
    ts=0
    for p in range(per + (1 if f<extra else 0)):
        block.append(['packet',fid,ts,0,300+p%50]); ts+=1; ops+=1
    block.append(['close',fid]); ops+=1
    blocks.append(block)
while ops<218432:
    blocks[-1].append(['install','m']); ops+=1
req={'capacity':{'range':4096,'exact':4096},'releases':[rel],'blocks':blocks}
data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('bytes', len(data))
start=time.time()
out=execute(read_request(io.BytesIO(data)))
print('clusters', len(out['catalog'][0]['clusters']), 'kept', len(out['catalog'][0]['priority']))
print('%.2fs rss=%dMB' % (time.time()-start, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss//1024))
PYEOF
